metas.name: Mareechika
metas.description: Follows Venkata Laxmi, a village girl who claims Sanju has been murdered, and introduces Mareechika, a US-returned woman, into his life, leading to shifting relationships and a murder investigation.

metas.name: Maremma
metas.description: In a village bound by ancient traditions, the Maremma Goddess festival is a time of both reverence and fear. Every 12 years, a male bull is sacrificed to the deity, yet with each ceremony, calamity befalls the villagers. Despite their efforts, the elders fail to prevent disaster. Determined to break the cycle, they enact a new decree: any household whose bull bears a male calf in the next 100 days must offer it to the goddess. As the deadline approaches, the fate of the village hangs in the balance, and the true test of their resolve begins.

metas.name: MCOCA
metas.description: It is a gritty crime thriller where a brother takes on a corrupt system after his sister disappears, crossing the line of the law to seek truth, justice and revenge.

metas.name: Meesaya Murukku 2
metas.description: After heartbreak and turmoil, Jeeva uncovers his father's quiet sacrifices, inspiring him to chase his musical dreams and make his family proud.

metas.name: Mension House Mallesh
metas.description: In a quiet village where gossip spreads faster than the wind, a swaggering young man becomes the talk of the town after his wedding night sparks unexpected rumours. What follows is a hilarious chain of misunderstandings, ego clashes, and small-town chaos. Mension House Mallesh is a lively rural entertainer packed with satire and nonstop laughter.

metas.name: Mission C1000
metas.description: Hindu Atankwad and the Honey Trap is a film about a character named Ram who tries to stop terrorists from stealing a scientific formula. The movie explores themes of patriotism, cultural identity, and the fight against terrorism

metas.name: Modha Rathiri
metas.description: Two strangers are brought together at an unusual wedding where, in one night, too many surprises unfold and several lies are told, spiraling into chaos that changes everything.

metas.name: Mollywood Times
metas.description: Vineeth Madhavan tries hard to become Malayalam cinema's greatest horror filmmaker, but will the toxic industry affect his dream?

metas.name: Momacu
metas.description: On a freezing winter night in rural Haryana, three men steal an ATM and hide it in a tube well room. Overnight, mistrust and chaos shatter their desperate plan.

metas.name: Mrithyunjay
metas.description: An intense murder investigation unfolds when a man refuses to accept a death casually deemed natural by the police. As he digs deeper, what begins as doubt turns into a relentless pursuit of truth, uncovering layers of deception and danger

metas.name: My Lord
metas.description: A man and his wife battle bureaucracy after being wrongly declared dead, while he confronts a kidney trafficking ring connected to corrupt politicians that destroyed his life.

metas.name: Nagabandham The Secret Treasure
metas.description: A chosen warrior protects a mystical, serpent-bound Himalayan temple from those seeking to steal the power of the Brahma Kamalam, a divine relic.

metas.name: Nari Nari Naduma Murari
metas.description: A young man's life turns upside down when he finds himself caught between two women, leading to an unexpected love triangle filled with emotions, misunderstandings, and tough decisions. As relationships intertwine, he must confront his feelings, face reality, and choose what truly matters, blending romance with heartfelt family drama.

metas.name: Nawab Cafe
metas.description: A family grapples with communication barriers as a father and son circle around conversations they desperately need but cannot bring themselves to have.

metas.name: Nee Forever
metas.description: A Gen Z couple meets via dating app. Their relationship unfolds with unexpected consequences.

metas.name: Newton's 3rd Law
metas.description: Follows an investigation into a double murder in 1999, with unexpected characters roped into the case as they search for justice amid intrigue and secrets.

metas.name: Nilakanta
metas.description: Saraswathipuram is a Village,where Education is Well Valued.nilakanta Work as a Tailor in That Village.nilakanta is Wise and Good From Childhood, He Believes in Karma but Unfortunately Karma Curses Him, No Matter How Big an Opponent He is,he Fights Bravely for His Life.who is That Rival ?

metas.name: Nooru Kodi Vaanavil
metas.description: Vino and Fenny's lives intertwine in a poignant tale of love, hope, and heartbreak.

metas.name: Obsess
metas.description: A young woman's life spirals into fear after a road rage encounter with a disturbed stranger whose anger and obsession become a terrifying nightmare of revenge, suspense, emotional trauma, and psychological chaos.

metas.name: Oh ! Sukumari
metas.description: Follows an aspiring politician who falls in love with Sukumari, a beautiful and soft-natured woman, while her father conceals a secret that threatens their relationship.

metas.name: Paatki
metas.description: A man certain of his guilt faces a world certain of his innocence, and the truth shatters them both.

metas.name: Pallichattambi
metas.description: Set in the politically turbulent late 1950s, Krishnan Pillai, a playful ruffian chosen by the Church to lead a defensive force, the Christopher Sena. His mission to resist the Communist government takes a detour when he experiences an ideological awakening and falls in love with a comrade, sparking an epic tale of rebellion against feudal power and oppression.

metas.name: Parasakthi
metas.description: In a time of civil disobedience in the erstwhile Madras state, a ruthless intelligent officer turns up with a duty to track down rebels. Chezhian and his brother Chinndurai are of different personalities, one a hardworking fireman, the other a rebel. A deadly game of cat and mouse ensues as Chezhian is forced to abandon his peaceful ways to protect his people and takes on the mighty forces, culminating in a fierce battle for justice.

metas.name: Parimala and Co
metas.description: A dark comedy centered around a chaotic family whose tangled relationships and unpredictable situations lead to emotionally charged and absurd moments, blending humor with underlying tension and drama.

metas.name: Patriot
metas.description: When a Malayali DRW analyst tries to expose a corrupt regional politician from Kerala and his malpractices regarding spyware, he goes on the run, becomes a vlogger, and must clear his name of the false allegations levelled against him.

metas.name: Peddi
metas.description: In a village that doesn't officially exist, a laborer's unmatched athletic talent becomes his weapon to fight for his people's right to be recognized.

metas.name: Pennum Porattum
metas.description: When a woman and her dog face public hostility, a village's hidden tensions erupt. A stark examination of mob mentality, social judgment, and how communities can turn cruel when seeking to punish perceived wrongs.

metas.name: Pitt Siyapa
metas.description: Nimmi, a clever young woman, transforms her father's death into an unusual business running virtual funerals for NRIs. With her ragtag crew, she orchestrates chaotic send-offs until NRI Mickey arrives, sparking hilarious chaos and romance.

metas.name: Pradhama Drishtiya Kuttakkar
metas.description: After her husband's tragic death, Aleena joins the police force through a compassionate appointment. What begins as a quiet new chapter soon turns into a high-stakes battle of wits and courage, testing everything she believes about justice, loyalty, and herself.

metas.name: Prathichaya
metas.description: After Kerala’s Chief Minister dies in a scandal engineered by a ruthless media tycoon, his son a brilliant tech entrepreneur enters the blood-soaked arena of politics to expose the conspiracy, vindicate his father, and turn technology against those who weaponized it

metas.name: Premada Oorali
metas.description: Premada Oorali is a heartfelt love story set in picturesque villages in the 2020s. The film intertwines romance and family drama, exploring the relationships between a father and son, as well as a boy and girl, as they navigate through intriguing, yet relatable, relationship challenges.

metas.name: Pyaar Prema Kalyanam
metas.description: When a bride refuses to leave her family home after marriage, her husband must find out if he can adjust to life under his in-laws' roof.

metas.name: Raakaasa
metas.description: Returning home after a decade, an NRI chasing romance inadvertently awakens an ancient darkness long feared by his village. As the threat intensifies, love turns deadly and life hangs in the balance.

metas.name: Ranabaali
metas.description: Set in 19th-century British India, a fierce leader rises from a drought-stricken land to fight colonial oppression and atrocities.

metas.name: Rao Bahadur
metas.description: Plagued by guilt and fear, an eccentric aristocrat retreats into his ancestral manor, creating an alternate world that deeply blurs reality and imagination.

metas.name: Razor
metas.description: When a little girl is hunted to be killed by a powerful politician and his ruthless criminal network, an unassuming dog groomer becomes her guardian angel as her fate dangles between survival and certain death.

metas.name: Repu Udayam 10 Gantalaku
metas.description: A deadly countdown begins when strangers receive an ultimatum: escape before 10 a.m. tomorrow or face catastrophic consequences. With hours ticking away, survival depends on outrunning an escalating threat.

metas.name: Romanchakam
metas.description: An entrepreneur hoping to make money off romance ends up falling in love. But when she blocks him on social media, he tries to reignite their spark.

metas.name: Samarpit Father's Love
metas.description: Samarpit Father's Love is an emotional story of Ashok, a simple farmer whose life changes forever after losing his wife during the birth of their son, Harsh.After tragedy strikes again when his crops are destroyed in a fire, Ashok sacrifices everything to raise and educate his son.Through hunger, struggle, and endless hardships, he dedicates his entire life to giving Harsh a better future. But when old age arrives and Ashok needs his son the most, life takes an unexpected emotional turn.A heart-touching tale of every father who silently sacrifices his dreams and happiness for his children.

metas.name: Sambhavam Adhyayam Onnu
metas.description: Three Kerala Police officers venture into a mysterious forest on the Kerala-Tamil Nadu border to find a missing officer. They encounter strange time-related phenomena, uncovering the hidden secrets of Velloorkkatt forest.

metas.name: Sampradayaini Suppini Suddapusaani
metas.description: After the accidental murder of a police sergeant, a man and his family are forced to cover up their tracks to avoid suspicion.

metas.name: Sardar 2
metas.description: When the mysterious Black Dagger threatens national security, Inspector Vijay embarks on his most dangerous mission yet. As the battle unfolds, the extraordinary origin of legendary spy Sardar is finally revealed, uncovering the sacrifices that forged a legend and the secrets that could shape the future.

metas.name: Satan The Dark
metas.description: Set in the fictional village of Asthinapuram, near Tamil Nadu–Kerala border, When Alisha and her mother desperate to escape the cursed land long belongs to colonial-era witchcraft and black magic, they find themselves spiraling into a deeper sinister. With only Alisha’s boyfriend standing by them, the trio must confront the horrors that dwell in silence… and the curse that refuses to be outrun.

metas.name: Sathi Leelavathi
metas.description: Leelavathi is a successful and spirited film director whose marriage with Ram Sethu begins falling apart. The relationship is strained by ego, changing gender roles, and the husband feeling overshadowed by his wife's success. Things complicate further when Sethu asks for a divorce and admits he has feelings for another woman, Nicola Sebastian. The couple is then forced to confront unresolved feelings and unearth hidden truths about their marriage.

metas.name: Sattendru Maarudhu Vaanilai
metas.description: When a carefree orphan and a runaway minister's daughter marry on impulse, their love is tested by financial struggles and powerful enemies — from corrupt politicians to jealous rivals. Together, they uncover hidden truths and prove that love can survive even the darkest threats.

metas.name: Second Case of Seetharam
metas.description: Inspector Seetharam, hoping to reunite with his estranged sister after years apart, must track down a brutal, psychotic serial killer terrorising the town of Anegadde.

metas.name: Sigma
metas.description: A daring treasure hunter throws caution to the wind, outwitting deadly traps and treacherous allies with sheer nerve and cunning.

metas.name: Sing Geetham
metas.description: In an isolated village, young Prathap seeks opportunity but enters a world of deception. Drawn into uncontrollable forces, he's caught between progress and preservation, testing his beliefs and purpose.

metas.name: Srinivasa Mangapuram
metas.description: Vasu Babu and Manga are living in their own blissful world, until a ruthless threat targets their romance. As powerful enemies move to separate them, Vasu must fight for his woman.

metas.name: Super Hit
metas.description: The film is a chaotic, comedic road trip that begins when a journalist disappears, sparking rumors involving "Big Brothers". Satya (Gowrav Shetty) impulsively takes a car, only for Madhu (Shwetha V) to jump in while fleeing goons. A masked man, Munna Bhai (Gilli Nata), joins them later, turning the journey into an unpredictable adventure filled with eccentric characters. The story blends comedy, light romance, and crime, ultimately concluding with a courtroom scene.

metas.name: Suyodhana
metas.description: A young Foley artist has grown up hearing a mysterious voice called Suyodhana and often visualises a figure resembling Duryodhana. Raised by his mother and supported by his childhood friend and partner, his life takes a turn when he is accused of his father’s murder, leading to an investigation that uncovers deeper layers of his past.

metas.name: Tavvai
metas.description: In 1880, A Maharaj through his atrocities invited Tavvai. The village is terrified for generations until a chosen one sets things right.

metas.name: Thaai Kizhavi
metas.description: An elderly and feared moneylender from a village near Madurai falls seriously ill, prompting her estranged sons and extended family to reunite after years of separation. As tensions rise inside the household, hidden motives, family conflicts, and expectations over her wealth turn her uncertain condition into the center of a chaotic family drama.

metas.name: The Dark Heaven
metas.description: In the Hill Village of Mekkarai, Where It is Customary for Men to Die Every Seven Years During the Month of June, a Newly Appointed Police Inspector Arrives to Investigate a Series of Mysterious Murders. As He Digs Deeper Into the Village's Dark Secrets and Long-standing Beliefs, He Finds Himself Trapped in a Web of Crime, Fear, and Hidden Truths.

metas.name: The Paradise
metas.description: In 1980s Secunderabad, a marginalized tribe battles discrimination and fights for citizenship under an unexpected leader's guidance, challenging systemic oppression.

metas.name: The Raja Saab
metas.description: Seeking his lost grandfather, a young man enters a haunted mansion and awakens a family curse powerful enough to upend both his life and reality.

metas.name: The Rise of Ashoka
metas.description: An educated young man abandons his dream of becoming a government officer to protect his village from a ruthless "hair mafia." He takes up arms to fight deep-rooted caste exploitation and secure justice for his community.

metas.name: The Secret of Devkaali
metas.description: Madhav, chosen by the Goddess, must stop Hemant Acharya's manipulation of Devkali's Pariyaar community. A violent faction emerged, threatening peace. A curse left daughters unmarried as two groups split apart.

metas.name: Thudakkam
metas.description: When danger strikes, a young woman fights to survive through courage and determination.

metas.name: TN 2026
metas.description: Folder: South_Indian

metas.name: Toxic
metas.description: A powerful drug cartel pulls the strings behind a facade of sun-soaked beaches as a gritty, violent underworld power struggle emerges during the crumbling of Portuguese colonial rule.

metas.name: Ugly Story
metas.description: Follows a man who becomes obsessively attached to a girl in love with someone else, descending into a dark psychological state as he struggles with rejection, leading to dangerous consequences.

metas.name: Unmadham
metas.description: Haunted by his past, a police constable reopens an unsolved cold case. As hidden secrets surface, he must confront truths that challenge his beliefs forever.

metas.name: Ustaad Bhagat Singh
metas.description: A tribal boy is shaped by the values of his teacher, who gives him the name 'Bhagat Singh'. He grows up deeply rooted in strong morals, which guide his actions throughout his life.He stands firm against injustice and takes on powerful evil forces, even when facing overwhelming odds.

metas.name: Uyir
metas.description: SI Ajeeb, a probationary officer posted in a Kerala town, investigates the mysterious death of an unidentified woman whose decomposed body is found in a well. Despite a lack of evidence and official support, he relentlessly pursues the truth with the help of ASI Joy while battling his own psychological struggles. Inspired by true events, the film follows his quest for justice in a case that changes his life forever.

metas.name: Vaa Vaathiyaar
metas.description: After being raised as the reincarnation of a famous actor, a man finds himself clashing with his grandfather's expectations of him.

metas.name: Vaazha II Biopic of a Billion Bros
metas.description: Four friends – Hashir, Alan, Ajin and Vinayak – are considered losers and troublemakers by parents, family and the school management. They face immense social pressure as they reach adulthood, embarking them on an emotional journey of self discovery and acceptance, where they finally learn to take up their responsibilities and find success.

metas.name: Vadam
metas.description: A action packed Village Family Drama. Hero’s Extraordinary Bond with his Bull. Story based on “Vada Manju Virattu”.  Family relationship highlighted emotionally

metas.name: Vadhala
metas.description: A seemingly perfect couple's life takes an unsettling turn when an unexpected presence enters their world. What begins as admiration slowly spirals into emotional chaos, blurring the lines between love, attachment, and obsession.

metas.name: Valathu Vashathe Kallan
metas.description: A police officer being investigated for his role in a woman’s death rushes to save his son from her vengeful father.

metas.name: Valavaara
metas.description: Amid the misty hills of Sakleshpur, Karnataka, Valavaara unfolds as a sweeping coming-of-age drama about brotherhood, loyalty, and the weight of responsibility. Kundeshi, a quiet boy from a struggling farming family, has always lived in the shadow of his younger brother, Kosudi - their father's clear favorite. When the boys take their pregnant cow out to graze, it vanishes into the countryside and tramples a neighbor's field, setting off a desperate search. With their father's return looming, Kundeshi must track down the animal before disaster strikes. His journey through rugged terrain and simmering family tensions forces him to confront his own insecurities and discover what it truly means to grow up. Lyrical and emotionally charged, Valavaara is a poignant portrait of rural childhood, responsibility, and the fragile bonds that hold families together.

metas.name: Vanaveera
metas.description: A descendant of the Vanara clan is pushed into conflict when a modern-day Ravana seizes his only bike for an election rally. What starts as a petty injustice soon erupts into a fierce fight for self-respect and dignity.

metas.name: Vishnu Vinyasam
metas.description: A superstitious man confronts his deepest convictions when he discovers that the woman he has fallen for has a dark secret.

metas.name: Vishwanath and Sons
metas.description: A celebrated Olympian shooter travels to America looking for a donor to help his sick child — but unexpected romance complicates his search.

metas.name: With Love
metas.description: Sathya reluctantly agrees to a blind date arranged by his sister and meets Monisha. They discover they attended the same school years ago. Bonding over shared memories and old crushes, they reconnect with their past and grow closer.

metas.name: Youth
metas.description: Youth follows Praveen, a 15-year-old boy who enters adolescence determined to find true love before school ends. As he goes through multiple relationships and heartbreaks, he slowly begins to understand what love truly means. Along the way, the experiences shape his growth, maturity, and outlook on life.

metas.name: 14 Days Girlfriend Intlo
metas.description: Harsha gets trapped in his girlfriend Ahana's house with no way of escaping without being seen by her parents.

metas.name: 28 Degree Celsius
metas.description: 28 degrees celsius is a romantic suspense thriller centred around Anjali, who suffers from a brain injury that makes her vulnerable to extreme temperatures and she must remain at a constant 28C to survive. As Karthik fights to protect her, unexpected twists unfold, blending love and suspense in a gripping narrative that keeps audiences on the edge.

metas.name: 3BHK
metas.description: A middle-class family battles financial hurdles and personal setbacks while pursuing their dream of owning a home in the bustling city.

A captivating new project by Suraj Production and the Magical Composer’s Debut film, #45Themovie is set to redefine the cinema-watching experience with its unique narrative and compelling performances.

metas.name: Aaromaley
metas.description: Ajith, a romantic dreamer faces reality when forced to work at a matchmaking agency under Anjali,a pragmatic, grounded woman, devoid of dreamy illusions. Their conflicting ideologies become the foundation of a relationship that’s as charming as it is unfiltered.

metas.name: Aaryan
metas.description: A struggling writer announces he'll commit the perfect crime, sparking a tense pursuit as police try to prevent his methodically planned killing spree.

metas.name: Ace
metas.description: Kannan,  with a past comes to Malaysia to turn over a new leaf. But when he realises that the girl he loves needs money to get out of a difficult situation, he commits a robbery that makes him the target of a fearsome gangster and the girl’s stepfather, an immoral cop.

metas.name: Aghathiyaa
metas.description: Things go awry when a haunted mansion is opened as a tourist attraction by Aghathiyan leading to the unraveling of the dark history behind the mansion's previous occupant.

metas.name: Aghathiyaa
metas.description: Things go awry when a haunted mansion is opened as a tourist attraction by Aghathiyan leading to the unraveling of the dark history behind the mansion's previous occupant.

metas.name: Akaal The Unconquered
metas.description: Set in 1840s Punjab, Sardar Akaal Singh and his village as they face a vengeful assault by Jangi Jahan and his forces after the death of Maharaja Ranjeet Singh. Amid broken truces and escalating tensions, the fearless Sardars must rise against overwhelming odds to protect their land. Will they prevail against this formidable foe?

metas.name: Akhanda 2 Thaandavam
metas.description: When all hope died, Akhanda arrived. He saved his family, protected his people, killed the wrongdoers, and retreated into isolation. But years later, new threats emerge putting the world in danger. And as the world burns, Akhanda returns.

metas.name: Alappuzha Gymkhana
metas.description: A group of youngsters, after failing their plus two exams, aims to join a common college through the sports quota. They choose boxing as their sport. By luck, they manage to survive the district-level competitions. But what will happen at the higher levels?

metas.name: Am Ah Doosri Maa
metas.description: Folder: South_Indian

metas.name: Anaganaga
metas.description: A school teacher uses innovative storytelling methods to help struggling students, overcoming various challenges to achieve his goal.

metas.name: Andhra King Taluka
metas.description: A heartfelt tribute to fan culture, the story follows Sagar, an ardent fan whose life, relationships, and identity revolve around his admiration for his cinematic idol, 'Andhra King' Surya Kumar.

metas.name: Arjun Chakravarthy Journey of an Unsung Champion
metas.description: Arjun Chakravarthy: Journey of an Unsung Champion is an inspiring sports drama that chronicles the extraordinary life of Arjun Chakravarthy, a determined kabaddi player who represented India in the 1980s.

metas.name: Arjun SO Vyjayanthi
metas.description: Folder: South_Indian

metas.name: Arjun Son of Vyjayanthi
metas.description: Arjun, an IPS aspirant turned kind-hearted gangster, learns that Pathaan, a notorious terrorist, wants to exact revenge on his principled mother Vyjayanthi, an honest IPS officer, and sets out to protect Vyjayanthi and their bond is put to the test.

metas.name: Asthram
metas.description: Asthram is a gripping crime thriller that delves into a series of puzzling suicides, where victims are found stabbed under eerily similar circumstances. Determined to uncover the truth, Inspector Akilan tasked himself to investigate the case. As the investigation unfolds, Akilan gathers crucial evidence that links each case, unraveling a web of secrets.

metas.name: Avihitham
metas.description: A drunken man's encounter sets off a chain of gossip in a town of secrets. As whispers spread, a woman's hidden past threatens to tear everything apart.

metas.name: B Tech
metas.description: Folder: South_Indian

metas.name: Baahubali The Epic
metas.description: When a mysterious child is found by a tribal couple near a roaring waterfall, they raise him as their own. As he grows, Sivudu is drawn to the world beyond the cliffs, where he discovers the ancient kingdom of Mahishmati, ruled by a cruel tyrant, haunted by rebellion, and bound to his past. What begins as a quest for love soon unravels a legacy of betrayal, sacrifice, and a forgotten prince.

metas.name: Baapu
metas.description: Folder: South_Indian

metas.name: Baapu A Fathers Story
metas.description: Mallanna's father decides to trade his life to secure relief funds for the family, but forgets. Funding for his final days, how will they make the ends meet?
